decisions.reason: The product's prospects remain uncertain and keeping it on the market costs little, so the firm holds the option open.
With no negative results yet and low continued investment required, the option is kept alive until uncertainty resolves.
The product is still an open option with uncertain value, and the firm has no signal to abandon it while keeping costs are low.
As an option whose value is not yet revealed, the product is retained because abandonment would forgo potential upside at little current cost.
